description: Makes a report the template of a new burst, and answers the burst, named after the report and with no variants yet. Add them with addBurstVariants. A Rollstack report's variants differ by the report parameters in parameterIds, found with getReportParameters. An older report's variants differ by the filters in filters, found with listReportSyncFilters: a folder is made for the burst in Google Drive or OneDrive and the report's file is copied into it as the template, which can take a minute. Only the report's editors may.

driveId.description: For an older report: the shared drive `parentFolderId` is in. Leave it out for a folder in your own drive.

filters.description: For an older report, such as a Google Slides or PowerPoint file: the filters of its syncs the variants differ by.

primaryIds.description: The filters that name the variants, by their `id` from `listReportSyncFilters`, in the order their values name a variant. 1 to 3. With more than one, each variant's file goes in a folder per value, one level per filter.

secondaryIds.description: Filters a variant can also set, which don't name it, by their `id` from `listReportSyncFilters`.

parameterIds.description: For a Rollstack report: the template report's parameters the variants differ by, by their `id` from `getReportParameters`, in the order their values name a variant. Each must be `burstable` there. At least one.

parentFolderId.description: For an older report: the Google Drive or OneDrive folder to create the burst's folder in, by its id in that drive. The template and the variants' files go in the burst's folder. Defaults to the top of your drive.

templateReportId.description: The report to make the template of the burst, by its `id` from `listReports`. You must be able to edit it, and it can't already be part of a burst. A Rollstack report must have datasheets, and becomes the template as it is. An older report must have syncs: its file is copied into a new folder for the burst, and the copy becomes the template.

variantNaming.description: How each variant's report is named from the burst's name and the name the variant is added with, `EMEA` in a burst named `Regional Review`: `suffix` gives `Regional Review - EMEA`, `prefix` gives `EMEA - Regional Review`, and `sameName` gives `EMEA`. It applies to variants added from then on. Defaults to `suffix`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

name: createBurst
title: Create burst
